name: claude-code-net-tools
description: Local VPN/proxy-aware MCP web search and URL fetch tools for Claude Code.

scripts.check: node --check claude_net_mcp.mjs && (py -3 -m py_compile claude_net_mcp.py || python3 -m py_compile claude_net_mcp.py || python -m py_compile claude_net_mcp.py)
scripts.test: npm run check && node tests/p1p2.mjs && node tests/search-quality.mjs && node tests/mcp-regression.mjs && node tests/safety-regression.mjs && node tests/browser-owner.mjs && node tests/p0.mjs
